description: Build a fluid typography/spacing value: CSS clamp() that grows linearly from a size at a small viewport to a size at a large viewport (sizes and viewports in px), expressed in rem or px. Also returns the computed size at sample viewport widths. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/css-units/

maxSize.description: Size in px at the large viewport. Default 32.

maxViewport.description: Large viewport width in px. Default 1280.

minSize.description: Size in px at the small viewport. Default 16.

minViewport.description: Small viewport width in px. Default 320.

rootFontSize.description: Root (html) font size in px, for rem. Default 16.

sampleViewports.description: Viewport widths (px) to compute the resulting size at.

name: css_clamp
title: Fluid CSS clamp()
